title: Florencia Colazo | Systems Analyst & Full Stack Developer
description: Systems Analyst & Full Stack Developer, advanced Information Systems student. Web and app development.
name: Florencia Colazo
headline: I turn real business problems into *software people use every day.*
tagline: Systems Analyst and full stack developer. I understand the business, design the solution and ship it: from the first conversation to a working system.
about: I'm a Systems Analyst and an advanced student of the Bachelor's in Information Systems. Before coding, I spent over ten years on the other side of the counter: serving customers, selling and running a store. That taught me something you don't learn at university: understand what people need before writing a single line of code. Today I build complete systems, from requirements and data modeling to the interface and deployment, that real teams use every day.

process.title: I understand the problem
process.text: I gather requirements by talking to the people who will use the system, not just the ones who ask for it.

process.title: I design the solution
process.text: I model the data, define the flows and sketch the interface before writing code.

process.title: I build end to end
process.text: Frontend, backend and database, with clean, maintainable code.

process.title: I ship and stay involved
process.text: I deploy, train the team and keep improving the system based on real use.

projects.title: AgenConecta
projects.subtitle: WhatsApp administration · Campaigns and shared inbox
projects.description: Web app to send WhatsApp Business campaigns and manage a shared inbox so the team can reply to incoming messages.
projects.problem: An internet provider's support team answered WhatsApp without knowing who was handling each customer, and outage or payment notices were sent one by one.
highlights: Shared inbox with statuses, conversation assignment, tags and internal notes.
Campaigns with Meta-approved templates and tracking of sent, failed and skipped messages.
Area notices for outages, a maintenance schedule and contact data quality checks.

projects.title: La Camisería Urbana
projects.subtitle: Shirt e-commerce · Store and admin panel
projects.description: Online store with catalog, search and filters, favorites, shopping bag and Mercado Pago checkout, plus email confirmations. Includes an admin panel for products, stock by size and color, sales and a promotions calendar.
projects.problem: University project: design and build a complete e-commerce, with real payments, stock management and an admin panel, using Kanban.
highlights: Store with catalog, search and filters, favorites, shopping bag and Mercado Pago checkout.
Admin panel: products, stock by size and color, sales and a promotions calendar.
GraphQL API in Rust with Redis caching and rate limiting.

projects.title: Internet Services Agency Website
projects.subtitle: Website and admin panel
projects.description: Website for an internet provider in San José, Entre Ríos: plans, bundles, coverage map and an admin panel with authentication.
projects.problem: Customers had to call the office to ask about plans or find out whether fiber reached their home.
highlights: Plans and bundles catalog, FAQ and direct WhatsApp contact.
Coverage map where customers check their street and request installation.
Admin panel with authentication and its own API.

projects.title: SyncPanel
projects.subtitle: Supplier sync with Tiendanube
projects.description: Panel that syncs catalog, prices and stock from wholesale suppliers with the online store, automatically loads paid orders into the supplier's cart and shows logs in real time. Includes a promotions generator.
projects.problem: Keeping two wholesale suppliers' catalog, prices and stock up to date in the online store was manual, and every order had to be entered by hand at the supplier.
highlights: Syncs catalog, prices and stock from wholesale suppliers to Tiendanube.
Automatically places paid orders in the supplier's cart.
Real-time logs and a promotions generator.
